title: Feature governance timeline and risk ledger
body:
Overview:
This document combines a timeboxed feature governance timeline with an operational risk ledger and a condensed prelaunch checklist. Purpose: give product-ops and cross-functional partners a single pane to track milestone health, owners, acceptance thresholds, and contingency plans for mid-size to large feature launches (0.5–5.0 M monthly requests expected).

How to use this sheet:
- Update the timeline row whenever dates slip; color-code status in your local sheet view (green/amber/red).
- Each risk entry needs an owner and an explicit mitigation with OKR-aligned success metric and a trigger for escalation.
- Decision gate rows capture the minimal data required for an asynchronous go/no-go message to execs.

Governance cadence (weekly):
- Tuesday deep-dive (30m): owners update status and risks; prepare 3-line summary for execs.
- Thursday readiness sync (15m): cross-functional blockers only.
- Ad-hoc runway call: triggered when any decision gate flips to RED.

Timeline (canonical rows — copy into tracker view):
Milestone | Target date | Owner | Stage status | Stage gate criteria | Contingency
M1: Feature spec freeze | 2024-11-18 | PM: Asha P. | Amber | Spec doc + acceptance tests + privacy review complete | De-scope optional personalization; ship core intent only
M2: Integration QA start | 2024-12-02 | Eng Lead: Liam C. | Amber | 80% test pass in staging; perf baseline within 1.5x of target | Limit parallel workloads; enable degraded model fallback
M3: Canary (internal) | 2024-12-16 | SRE: Diego A. | Green | 7d of stable telemetry; error rate < 0.5% | Pause incremental rollout, run hotfix window
M4: Beta customers | 2025-01-06 | PM Ops | Planned | Signed NDAs + support rota + runbook complete | Limit to 5 tenants; increase monitoring retention
M5: General availability | 2025-01-27 | GTM Lead | Planned | Business metrics forecast within 20% of model; security sign-off | Throttled traffic shaping for first 48h

Success metrics (observability + product):
- Health metrics to monitor (minimum): API p99 latency, token cost per request, error rate, median latency, model inference time, customer-reported severity-1s.
- Product success thresholds: activation conversion >= 8% in first 30 days (baseline 5%), retention N-day > baseline by +10% after 60 days.
- Financial guardrail: rolling 7d token cost burn predictability within 12% variance.

Risk ledger (live entries — add row per new risk):
1) Risk ID: R-34 | Title: Unstable quantized model variant under load | Owner: Liam Chen | Probability: Medium | Impact: High (latency spike) | Mitigation: revert to fp16 variant, enable KV cache, pre-warm nodes | Escalation trigger: p99 latency > 2x target for 30m | Current status: Watching
2) Risk ID: R-37 | Title: Customer data classification gaps for shared endpoints | Owner: Sofia Martinez | Probability: Low | Impact: Critical (compliance) | Mitigation: add content filter stage, require tenant-level encryption, perform audit with Security | Escalation trigger: L3 audit findings > 0 | Current status: Mitigated (audit scheduled)
3) Risk ID: R-41 | Title: Support rotation understaffing during beta | Owner: Diego Alvarez | Probability: High | Impact: Medium | Mitigation: onboard two rotation backups, create triage escalation ladder, create shared-runbook doc | Escalation trigger: >3 S1 tickets in 24h | Current status: Active (hiring in progress)

Decision gates (what to capture for asynchronous approvals):
- Gate name, date, owner, short rationale (1 line), yes/no/conditional decision, required mitigations before green.
Example gate row: "Canary to Beta" | 2024-12-20 | Asha Patel | "Telemetry stable; perf within 1.2x" | Conditional (DB write path iff fallback covered) | Required: enable canary fallback switch, add 30m rollback window to on-call rota

Prelaunch checklist (minimum viable set to validate before external traffic increase):
- Technical: perf profile + stress test (90th percentile traffic) completed; KV cache warming script exists; model variant regression tests passed.
- Reliability: SLA page drafted; runbook with rollback steps and owner contact table; health dashboards instrumented and alerts wired to on-call.
- Security & Compliance: DLP scans run; SSO + tenant isolation validated; compliance sign-off attached.
- GTM & Support: Support runbook + FAQ and first-48h rota assigned; billing & quota limits configured; partner comms template ready.

Escalation playbook (short):
- Severity classification: S1 (outage/customer-facing), S2 (degraded but functional), S3 (cosmetic or minor).
- For S1: page the on-call, convene incident lead, run rollback within 30m if not resolved.
- For risk ledger triggers: tag the risk row with the incident id and mark decision gate as "requires emergency review".

Notes and references:
- Narrow scope: this sheet is intended for mid-sized launches; copy into Project X tracker for massive infra changes.
- Reference docs: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/FEATURE-GOV-2024, README for canary procedures (internal).
- Related tickets: RDW-1123 (feature epic), RDW-1187 (canary automation), RDW-1250 (billing guardrails).

Open questions (to be resolved before gate M3):
- Finalize SLA threshold numbers (ops / legal) by 2024-11-22.
- Confirm cost alerting cadence and who owns chargeback communications.
- Decide whether personalization should be part of initial beta or post-GA roadmap (recommend post-GA).

Quick action items (owners):
- Asha: lock spec and update acceptance tests (due 2024-11-18).
- Liam: complete perf runbook and add fallback toggle (due 2024-11-30).
- Diego: finalize on-call rota and add backup engineer (due 2024-11-25).

If you copy this into the product-ops master sheet, maintain the Risk ID prefix and keep the date fields in ISO format.

Last edited by Asha Patel on 2024-11-20.
